init.title: Gateway state options
init.description: Enable missing-state fallback to keep entities usable while the gateway is synchronized and the device is still listed. Lights and switches initially show off; curtains show closed. Otherwise the last reported state in this loaded session is retained. Missing measurements stay unknown. Assumed values may affect automations. Reported invalid values are not replaced. Curtain position inversion is enabled by default. All discovered position-capable curtains are initially selected; deselect devices which already use 0 fully closed and 100 fully open. Saved selections are preserved; this reverses position display and targets, including both day/night positions, without changing open, close, stop or tilt.
